subject: Execution Bridge: final MAP signoff, signer windows and startweek contingencies
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Adams <claire.adams@apogeeretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Execution Bridge: final MAP signoff, signer windows and startweek contingencies

Claire —

Thanks for the productive demo last week. Per our MAP and evaluation plan, we want to lock the final go/no-go and the signing cadence so your teams can commit a start week. Proposed plan below:

- Signer roster & windows: Apogee legal + procurement signoff the week of Oct 11–15. Redwood exec signature window: Oct 18–19.
- Doc process: We prepare a DocuSign envelope with sequential routing (procurement -> legal -> apogee exec -> redwood exec).
- Contingency: If procurement needs more time, we hold a provisional start week of Nov 1 and do a one-week canary (10% capacity) for the first week of Nov.
- Dependencies: SOC2 evidence and SLA exhibit must be accepted ahead of procurement signoff.

I attached the updated MAP (APG-MAP-v3.pdf) and a draft SOW reflecting the evaluation milestones. Can you confirm the signer availability and whether DocuSign routing is acceptable? If procurement prefers eSign via your CLM, say so and we’ll hand off the redlines.

Next steps I propose:
1) Claire confirms procurement signoff window by EOD Oct 4
2) Redwood legal (Karthik & Soojin) triage any redlines by Oct 7
3) Final DocuSign envelope sent Oct 10

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
From: Claire Adams <claire.adams@apogeeretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Apogee Procurement <procure@apogeeretail.com>, Jason Sanders <jsanders@outsourced-legal.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Execution Bridge: final MAP signoff, signer windows and startweek contingencies

Jordan —

Thanks, this is helpful. High level: procurement prefers to complete commercial review the week of Oct 11, legal will likely want till Oct 13 for a cursory pass. A couple quick notes: 

- Procurement asks that we keep a three-business-day buffer between final redlines and DocuSign routing to allow CFO signoff.
- We typically use our CLM (I’ll confirm whether we need the envelope from Redwood or if Apogee initiates).
- Start week: Nov 1 provisional works for us; we’ll aim for full production Jan 3 if the evaluation flag meets the acceptance criteria.

I’ll sync with procurement and circle back by EOD Oct 4 with confirmed windows and whether we initiate the CLM flow.

—Claire
Claire Adams
Head of Product Ops | Apogee Retail

Jordan / team —

Quick triage after an initial read of the SOW + MAP: 

- Data retention: current wording matches our Private deployment defaults; procurement may request explicit retention periods. We can add a 90/365/730 tier table in an exhibit if they need granular options.
- Audit logs & SOC2 evidence: I attached a short stub note to the SOW clarifying delivery timing (SOC2 report provided ahead of procurement signoff).
- SLA exhibit: SLA has standard uptime and a credit ladder. Kim, confirm whether the Nov 1 canary can be covered under standard dedicated capacity guarantees or if we need to reserve a small pool.

Routing recommendation: sequential DocuSign but allow Apogee to originate if they prefer their CLM. We’ll prepare a clean e-sign-ready set (APG-MAP-v3 + SOW + SLA exhibit).

Redlines I expect: minor text for retention and one paragraph around audit sampling — should not delay Oct 11 if procurement stays on the timeline.

—Soojin

Confirming the timeline after your procurement note:

- Redwood will prepare the e-sign bundle and hold it ready. If Apogee prefers to originate the CLM envelope, we will accept that flow — either way we’ll use sequential routing.
- Target: procurement final redlines by Oct 11; DocuSign send window Oct 12 to allow your CFO buffer.
- Redwood exec signing window: Oct 18–19.
- Start week (provisional): Nov 1 (10% canary) — Kimberly confirms infra availability below. Full production start: Jan 3 if evaluation acceptance is met.

Attachments included: APG-MAP-v3.pdf, APG-SOW-v1.2.docx, Redwood-SLA-Exhibit.pdf (we will also share a DocuSign-ready PDF link).

DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.net/envelopes/detail?envId=0a1b2c3d4e

- Claire: confirm whether Apogee will originate CLM by Oct 4 (you previously indicated you’d confirm).
- Karthik/Soojin: finalize any redline blockers by Oct 7; if none, Jordan will send the envelope Oct 12.
- Kimberly: confirm infra can support 10% canary on Nov 1 by Oct 6.

Thanks — I’ll send a final summary and the envelope once I have procurement confirmation.
